beta_construction: Reuse the fixed seed=6 master profile from the matched-beta work. For each N, reshape to (N, 4800/N) and take nested block means; the same profile is used at every strength.
cross_size_path_definition: At each strength, embed both N subspaces on each common grid and retain the complete 2x2 cross-size overlap matrix. This is not itself same-N state tracking.
native_path_definition: For each N and each adjacent strength pair, compare same-rank and cross-rank two-dimensional native subspaces after reduced QR. Preserve all 16 links; finite links are not a continuous path proof.
entry_link_definition: For every cross-size matrix entry and adjacent strength pair, compute delta_O_ij, its score contribution delta_O_ij/2 and both singular-channel contributions delta_(s_k^2)/2. Dominance is numerical only.
representation_control: Retain cross-representation fidelity and native/embedded rank controls; do not normalize overlaps or use fidelity as a correction factor.
endpoint_policy: Recompute r=0.1 and r=0.2 only for path consistency and endpoint binding to batches B and C. These four cells are not counted as new realizations and are not merged into A+B+C counts.
outcome_policy: Retain every preregistered point and link, including any swapped or mixed assignments. Do not select favorable path segments or infer a crossing from discrete jumps.
